author: Zedther
body:
http://avicus.net/corey1149?tab=infractions
Corey has a very large amount of infractions,
mostly temp bans.
I believe he should be permanently banned (along with his alt sheamus4414)
as he has received a large amount of infractions, other than that, he has also received a large number of infractions after he was temp banned for excessive infractions.
This kind of behavior is not tolerated, and should be dealt with.
Thank you.
